resources.string: Strict Blocker

Monitors foreground applications to enforce your scheduled blocking rules. This service only detects the active app package name to block restricted apps outside their allowed time slots. It does NOT read screen content, keystrokes, or private messages.

This application is strictly blocked outside its designated schedule.
Accessibility Service
Instant zero-latency detection of foreground apps when they launch.
Without it, the blocker cannot immediately detect when you tap a blocked app.
Tap below, select \'Strict Blocker\' under Installed Services, and switch it ON.
Usage Access
System-level background usage query and fallback enforcement engine.
Required to verify foreground transitions and cross-check active app status.
Find \'Strict Blocker\' in the list and toggle \'Permit usage access\' to ON.
Display Over Other Apps
Displays the full-screen interrupt shield immediately over blocked applications.
Without overlay access, the blocker screen cannot interrupt the target app.
Toggle \'Allow display over other apps\' ON for Strict Blocker.
Unrestricted Battery (Samsung)
Prevents Samsung One UI from sleeping or killing the blocking engine.
Without unrestricted battery, One UI will terminate the background enforcement after a few hours of screen off.
Tap below, go to App Info > Battery, and choose \'Unrestricted\'.
Notifications & Foreground Service
Keeps the blocker background engine alive and provides active protection status.
Android requires a persistent notification for continuous background enforcement.
Allow notifications when prompted by the system.
Exact Alarms
Guarantees precise to-the-minute schedule cutoffs (e.g. blocking right at 7:00 PM).
Without exact alarms, schedule cutoffs could be delayed by up to 15 minutes by Doze mode.
Ensure \'Allow setting alarms and reminders\' is enabled.
